character.name: Unnamed
character.age: Approximately one month chronological; accelerated juvenile development
character.clothing: Oversized grey woollen cloth wrapped around body; barefoot
character.inventory: Nothing carried. Incubation pod left uphill in the ruined glasshouse; last observed with chamber, life support and integrated power functioning, lid open and amniotic nutrient fluid drained.
character.location: Vesalius • Aboard a maintenance rail vehicle descending toward distant lights
character.condition: Uninjured. Stable body–soul integration. No chronic pain.
character.language: Can clearly reproduce “Veskan” and associate it with him. Repeating other sounds; word boundaries and meanings in connected speech remain uncertain.
character.notes: Aboard the moving rail vehicle with Veskan and two companions. The entrance remains open. Maintaining watch over the occupants while examining the machinery.

journal.title: Planetfall
journal.body: The incubation pod came to rest in a shattered planting bed beneath a ruined glasshouse roof. Its chamber, life support and integrated power remained functional. The fluid drained and the lid opened. Beyond the terrace lay jungle, a hillside railway and distant buildings beside dark water. Three adults approached aboard a small rail vehicle.

journal.title: First steps
journal.body: The subject climbed out, caught himself during an initial stumble and established his balance without injury. Close inspection revealed abundant sensory detail, though unfamiliar sounds and movement remained difficult to interpret. The rail vehicle stopped below and a voice called uphill.

journal.title: The voice below
journal.body: Recognising a bodily resemblance to the occupants, the subject approached and tried to imitate their call. A loose stair broke beneath him; the surviving railing prevented a fall. The first vocal imitation was distorted. A man with a lamp signalled him to stop while a companion raised a rifle. The lampholder touched his own chest and repeated “Veskan”.

journal.title: A name repeated
journal.body: The subject identified the wooden and metal object as a probable weapon. Two slow angled steps placed Veskan across its line; the bearer lowered the muzzle. With an open palm raised, the subject touched his own chest and reproduced “Veskan” clearly. Veskan repeated his stopping gesture, then demonstrated the distinction between himself and the child. The vehicle’s engine was switched off.

journal.title: An offer of warmth
journal.body: The subject stopped, pointed to Veskan and repeated his name, then pointed to himself, hesitated and nodded. Veskan acknowledged the exchange without naming him. After speaking with his companions, he received a heavy grey cloth, placed the lamp on a trackside bracket and demonstrated wrapping the cloth around his shoulders. He now holds it open toward the child. The armed man keeps his weapon low and watches the vegetation.

journal.title: Cloth and speech
journal.body: The subject accepted the heavy grey cloth and wrapped it around himself as demonstrated. He continued copying the patrol’s speech. Isolated sounds could be reproduced, but connected speech remained difficult to divide and interpret. Veskan repeated gestures alongside sounds. The rifleman lowered his weapon away from the subject, and Veskan demonstrated the trolley footboard.

journal.title: Departure by rail
journal.body: The subject boarded voluntarily, studying the vehicle while remaining cautious about the occupants’ intentions. He observed the brake linkage and the engine’s connection to the moving drive. Veskan left the entrance chain unfastened and gestured to warn of the hot cover. The driver restarted the engine and released the brakes. The trolley began descending toward distant lights, leaving the pod in the ruined glasshouse.

records.relationships: Veskan — introduced himself, offered the grey cloth and demonstrated boarding. Now aboard alongside the subject. The rifle-bearing companion watches the rear with his weapon directed away; the third adult operates the vehicle. Their conduct shows cautious goodwill.
records.research: Observed the brake lever, connecting rod and wheel blocks moving together. Connected engine movement with the visible belt and drive shaft. Practical mechanical intuition is developing through observation; technical vocabulary remains unfamiliar. Speech imitation continues with gestures as context.
